# Scenario: short title

## Symptom
What the operator or the customer sees.

## Context and assumptions
Architecture, deployment model, what is assumed.

## What happens
Diagram and explanation of the failing flow.

## What is affected
Blast radius: users, network functions, services.

## Where to start
Ordered checks, each with the evidence it should produce.

## Hypotheses
Ranked by likelihood and cost to test: how to prove or discard each.

## Mitigate now vs. fix the root cause
Restore service first; then address the cause.

## Prevention
Alarms, limits, capacity, runbooks.

## Standard vs. implementation
Which parts come from 3GPP and which are vendor or configuration specific.
